slides.title: Packaging Design
slides.subtitle: FMCG pack artwork built as a shelf-ready flavour system.
slides.caption: 3 pieces

slides.title: Popcorn Tub Cover — Chilli Cheese
slides.caption: Retail tub wrap where the flavour drives the whole colour system: chilli red bleeding into cheese gold, the popcorn bowl holding the optical centre. Mandatory matter — ingredients, nutrition, allergens, FSSAI licence, barcode — is set tight into a left column so the shelf-facing half stays appetising.
slides.notes: Mother India · Sree Foods — Popcorn Tub Cover — Chilli Cheese. Retail tub wrap where the flavour drives the whole colour system: chilli red bleeding into cheese gold, the popcorn bowl holding the optical centre. Mandatory matter — ingredients, nutrition, allergens, FSSAI licence, barcode — is set tight into a left column so the shelf-facing half stays appetising.

slides.title: Popcorn Tub Cover — Chilli Tomato
slides.caption: The second SKU. Only the colour field and flavour lozenge move — sunflower ground, tomato-red type, chilli and tomato garnish — while masthead, bowl and legal column hold their exact positions. That discipline is what makes three packs read as one family from two metres away.
slides.notes: Mother India · Sree Foods — Popcorn Tub Cover — Chilli Tomato. The second SKU. Only the colour field and flavour lozenge move — sunflower ground, tomato-red type, chilli and tomato garnish — while masthead, bowl and legal column hold their exact positions. That discipline is what makes three packs read as one family from two metres away.

slides.title: Popcorn Tub Cover — Cream Onion
slides.caption: The mildest flavour takes the softest field: magenta-pink with cream accents and a spoon-and-onion garnish signalling savoury, not spicy. Same die-line, same typography, same barcode position — the system can absorb a fourth flavour without redrawing the pack.

slides.title: Print & Flyers
slides.subtitle: Leaflets and takeaway collateral that must work in the hand.
slides.caption: 3 pieces

slides.title: A4 Manufacturer Flyer
slides.caption: A trust-first leaflet for India's largest manufacturer of precipitated calcium carbonate. The range is shot as one family photograph rather than isolated packs, then six benefit blocks in a two-column grid carry the argument. Corporate green anchors the page; a QR code bridges print to web.
slides.notes: Shree Karni Chemicals — A4 Manufacturer Flyer. A trust-first leaflet for India's largest manufacturer of precipitated calcium carbonate. The range is shot as one family photograph rather than isolated packs, then six benefit blocks in a two-column grid carry the argument. Corporate green anchors the page; a QR code bridges print to web.

slides.title: Biryani Flyer — Front
slides.caption: The front face sells appetite before information. A full-bleed biryani hero fills the upper field with a hand-script overlay promising the dish at home. Address, delivery radius and a dial-now number are stacked into one quiet block so the food never competes with logistics.
slides.notes: Cinders Take Away — Biryani Flyer — Front. The front face sells appetite before information. A full-bleed biryani hero fills the upper field with a hand-script overlay promising the dish at home. Address, delivery radius and a dial-now number are stacked into one quiet block so the food never competes with logistics.

slides.title: Biryani Price List — Reverse
slides.caption: The reverse is pure utility. Veg and non-veg run as parallel columns so the customer compares across rather than down, and regular versus per-kilo bulk rates split into two banded blocks. One offer sits reversed out on the fold line, where the eye lands last.
slides.notes: Cinders Take Away — Biryani Price List — Reverse. The reverse is pure utility. Veg and non-veg run as parallel columns so the customer compares across rather than down, and regular versus per-kilo bulk rates split into two banded blocks. One offer sits reversed out on the fold line, where the eye lands last.

slides.title: Corporate Catalogue
slides.subtitle: Multi-page product literature for a manufacturing brand.
slides.caption: 2 pieces

slides.title: Catalogue — Inside Spread
slides.caption: An interior spread split between persuasion and proof. Five advantages are numbered 01–05 for fast scanning down the left page; the facing column carries spline-system construction drawings and a full specification table. The timber palette is sampled from the product itself.
slides.notes: Sungmi India Pvt. Ltd. — Catalogue — Inside Spread. An interior spread split between persuasion and proof. Five advantages are numbered 01–05 for fast scanning down the left page; the facing column carries spline-system construction drawings and a full specification table. The timber palette is sampled from the product itself.

slides.title: Catalogue — Outside Spread
slides.caption: The outer spread pairs an installed interior photograph with the cover panel. Four blunt badges — no water, no cement, no sand, no bricks — do the fast selling for a dry-installation system, while quick-install copy, features and the contact block close the fold.
slides.notes: Sungmi India Pvt. Ltd. — Catalogue — Outside Spread. The outer spread pairs an installed interior photograph with the cover panel. slides.caption: A map-listing thumbnail engineered to survive heavy downscaling. Condensed caps in high-visibility yellow and cyan lock over a real workshop photograph, and the service list is compressed to four words so the offer still resolves at map-pin size on a phone.

slides.title: Hose Expiry Safety Post
slides.caption: A public-safety message that had to feel warm, not bureaucratic. A diagonal split divides duty from delight: hazard-red cylinder and shield on the blue field, a child's smile on the yellow. One instruction, one interval, one call to action — nothing else competes.
slides.notes: Hindustan Petroleum · HP Gas — Hose Expiry Safety Post. A public-safety message that had to feel warm, not bureaucratic. slides.caption: Here the greeting and the business are the same idea — building new beginnings. The Gudi is raised against construction cranes at golden hour with tipper trucks entering frame, so a cement and aggregates supplier gets a festival post that still says what it sells.

slides.title: Political Communication
slides.subtitle: A consistent greeting series for a serving minister.
slides.caption: 3 pieces

slides.title: Teachers' Day Greeting
slides.caption: Staged on a chalkboard, with slate, apple and globe props establishing the occasion instantly. The minister is cut out and lit to sit forward of the board, and the designation bar is pinned bottom-left as the fixed element across the whole series.
slides.notes: Mauvin Godinho · BJP Goa — Teachers' Day Greeting. Staged on a chalkboard, with slate, apple and globe props establishing the occasion instantly. The minister is cut out and lit to sit forward of the board, and the designation bar is pinned bottom-left as the fixed element across the whole series.

slides.title: Ganesh Chaturthi Greeting
slides.caption: Built vertically for feed dominance. The idol is centred and richly lit against a deep field, the blessing runs in italic across the lower third, and the party mark holds the top corner. Different festival, identical structure — the series stays recognisable at thumbnail size.
slides.notes: Mauvin Godinho · BJP Goa — Ganesh Chaturthi Greeting. Built vertically for feed dominance. The idol is centred and richly lit against a deep field, the blessing runs in italic across the lower third, and the party mark holds the top corner. Different festival, identical structure — the series stays recognisable at thumbnail size.

slides.title: Republic Day Greeting
slides.caption: Reduced to three elements: a tricolour wash, the Ashoka Chakra, and a salute. Restraint is the entire design decision — date and greeting lock into the lower right so the flag is never crowded, and the same designation bar closes the frame.
slides.notes: Mauvin Godinho · BJP Goa — Republic Day Greeting. Reduced to three elements: a tricolour wash, the Ashoka Chakra, and a salute. slides.title: Menu Design
slides.subtitle: High-density food menus engineered to stay scannable.
slides.caption: 4 pieces

slides.title: Biryani, Gravies & Combos
slides.caption: A high-density menu that still scans. A deep red ground with gold rules divides veg and non-veg biryanis, gravies, breads, thalis and combos into vertical columns, and dotted leaders carry the eye from dish to price. Photography is rationed to one edge so it accents rather than crowds.
slides.notes: Restaurant Menu — Biryani, Gravies & Combos. A high-density menu that still scans. A deep red ground with gold rules divides veg and non-veg biryanis, gravies, breads, thalis and combos into vertical columns, and dotted leaders carry the eye from dish to price. Photography is rationed to one edge so it accents rather than crowds.

slides.title: Beverages, Policy & Location
slides.caption: The service panel. Beverages are priced in a tight table, operating policies become single icon lines instead of paragraphs, and the address is replaced with a drawn location map — faster for a customer than any written direction. A dish strip keeps the utility appetising.
slides.notes: Cinders Take Away — Beverages, Policy & Location. The service panel. Beverages are priced in a tight table, operating policies become single icon lines instead of paragraphs, and the address is replaced with a drawn location map — faster for a customer than any written direction. A dish strip keeps the utility appetising.

slides.title: Dum Biryani Menu
slides.caption: Charcoal-grill character built from wood grain, stencil marks and grill icons. Dum biryani listings sit above a full-width photographic strip that acts as a horizon line for the sheet, and a self-service note sets expectations before the customer reaches the counter.
slides.notes: Protaste Grill — Dum Biryani Menu. Charcoal-grill character built from wood grain, stencil marks and grill icons. Dum biryani listings sit above a full-width photographic strip that acts as a horizon line for the sheet, and a self-service note sets expectations before the customer reaches the counter.

slides.title: Sandwiches, Rolls & Beverages
slides.caption: The companion sheet extends the range across three columns — sandwiches, kathi rolls, pizza, burgers, fried rice and beverages. Script section headers do the dividing so no extra rules are needed, keeping a long list feeling lighter than it is.
